Table Mountain, Front Row Seats Include

Every street has its hierarchy, and Leeukloof Drive sits comfortably at the top of Tamboerskloof's. Known locally as its "Rodeo Drive", this is where Table Mountain stops being a backdrop and becomes the main attraction, visible, uninterrupted, from every angle of the house. You may find yourself greeting it in the mornings.

Across 430 m² under roof on a generous 713 m² erf, the home was built for living well. The open-plan kitchen spills into a lounge anchored by a wood-burning fireplace (winter, consider yourself handled), then glides through the dining room and out onto terraces and a sparkling pool. Entertaining here tends to run long.

The ground-floor primary en-suite is a sumptuous affair, with its own pyjama lounge next door, because the best part of the day deserves a room of its own. Upstairs, two further bedrooms each claim a private deck with outstanding views, sharing a full bathroom. With 3.5 bathrooms in total, the morning queue is officially cancelled.

Vaulted ceilings pour light through every room, giving the whole house an airy, unhurried calm. Outside, an irrigated indigenous garden wraps around the property, lush, low-fuss and looking after itself.

And for the collection? Triple garaging. Park the daily driver, the weekend car, and the one you don't talk about.

3 beds | 3.5 baths | Triple garage | Pool | 430 m² under roof | 713 m² erf

Joint mandate. Currently tenanted. Viewings strictly by appointment.
